function: The <a> tag defines a hyperlink, which is used to link from one page to another.

attributes.name: download
attributes.function: Specifies that the target will be downloaded when a user clicks on the hyperlink

attributes.name: href
attributes.function: Specifies the URL of the page the link goes to

attributes.name: hreflang
attributes.function: Specifies the language of the linked document

attributes.name: media
attributes.function: Specifies what media/device the linked document is optimized for

attributes.name: ping
attributes.function: Specifies a space-separated list of URLs to which, when the link is followed, post requests with the body ping will be sent by the browser (in the background). Typically used for tracking.

attributes.name: referrerpolicy
attributes.values: no-referrer | no-referrer-when-downgrade | origin | origin-when-cross-origin | same-origin | strict-origin-when-cross-origin | unsafe-url
attributes.function: Specifies which referrer information to send with the link

attributes.name: rel
attributes.values: alternate | author | bookmark | external | help | license | next | nofollow | noreferrer | noopener | prev | search | tag
attributes.function: Specifies the relationship between the current document and the linked document

attributes.name: target
attributes.function: Specifies where to open the linked document

attributes.name: type
attributes.function: Specifies the media type of the linked document
